summary: Iteration 28 — onboarding without a tour. Backend + frontend both green. 9/9 pytest tests pass covering setup-checklist shape/defaults/actions (shared/dismiss/restore/unknown->400), route-ordering (not shadowed by /{artist_id}), PATCH /auth/me → profile.done flip, upload+create artwork → artwork.done flip, and /api/settings.stripe_mode. Frontend: /how-it-works ($92.80, all sections, FAQ toggle, mobile 390px zero overflow), hero + footer links present; SetupChecklist card visible with '0 of 5 done', 5 items, checklist-profile → tab-story active, checklist-payouts → tab-payouts active, checklist-artwork → /studio/upload, /studio?tab=payouts deep link opens Payouts, dismiss hides card and stays hidden on reload; empty states render on /studio Artworks, /orders, /selling, /saved, /feed, /messages, /tickets and /explore (logged out) with correct CTAs; Cart shows escrow-note with 'Protected purchase' + How-it-works link + 'Stripe test mode · card 4242…' line (surfaced because settings.stripe_mode==='test').

ui_bugs.issue: When cart contains an artwork in status=pending_fee (not yet listed live), the cart line renders '$NaN' price and Total '$NaN' instead of gracefully filtering out or showing an unavailable-state. Escrow copy still shows fine.

action_items: Optional: In Cart, filter out or mark items whose /api/artworks/{id} lookup fails or returns status=pending_fee/removed so the total doesn't show '$NaN'.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.py setup_checklist is correctly placed before /{artist_id} — good. Note: publish.done requires published_at AND artworks>0, but the label says just 'Publish your studio' — could be misleading to an artist who has published but has no artworks yet (label + condition mismatch). Minor UX polish, not a bug.

SetupChecklist go() only handles tab= links via onTab; for the share step it calls share(). For 'publish' whose href is '/studio', it does nothing (no matching tab= regex) — but publish is a Link (not a button), because usesTab is only true if href has tab= or key==='share'. Publish is rendered as <Link to='/studio'> which is a same-page no-op. Consider making it a button that scrolls to Preview/Publish CTA.
